resources.string: Khetha indawo yenethiwekhi nomhlinzeki we-geocoding osetshenziswe ngemuva kokuqala kabusha. Ukukhetha kwakho akuyishintshi i-GPS noma izinsiza zendawo ezihlanganisiwe ze-Google.

Phakamisa i-Baidu NLP lapho inethiwekhi yeselula ebhalisiwe ibonisa izwe lase-China. Ukushintsha kuhlala kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kwakho nokuqalwa kabusha. I-Wi-Fi iyodwa ayikwazi ukusungula izwe lakini.
Qala kabusha ifoni yakho ukuze usebenzise umhlinzeki okhethiwe.
Vula imenyu yamandla efoni bese ukhetha Qala kabusha. Umhlinzeki okhethiwe uzolungiswa ekuqaliseni okulandelayo.
Khetha i-%1$s ukuze uqalise kabusha okulandelayo? Umhlinzeki osebenzayo uzoqhubeka uze uqale kabusha ifoni yakho.
Inethiwekhi yeselula ebhalisiwe: ngaphandle kwezwekazi laseChina
Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza ukucushwa komhlinzeki. Hlola okukhethiwe ngaphambi kokuqala kabusha.
Umhlinzeki okhethiwe akatholakali. Ukuqalisa kabusha kungase kungaxazululi isevisi engekho noma evimbelwe.
